platform: Apple Silicon Mac; Rust 1.95.0; release target-cpu=native; Python 3.12; mimalloc purge delay -1
scope: Original JavaScript grammar; JSB build requires pinned llguidance success, TBM requires finite matched problem/example/step measurements. No grammar rewrite.
defaults: Existing runtime and cache policies unchanged; no new opt-in required.

python_paired_screen.scope: Only LL-success builds; only exact LL-measured (problem,example,step) runtime keys
python_paired_screen.metric: mask_i+commit_i, minimum complete same-run pair over equal fresh-state repetitions

dynamic.comparison: independently frozen e599/48c5823 union-default release versus storage-only candidate; equal runtime defaults and pinned runner dependencies

selection.policy: First 1000 schemas in retained corpus order after llguidance-success filter; do not drop candidate failures

dynamic.metric: native commit_i to mask_i+1; minimum complete interval across two independent runs

static.comparison: independently frozen e599/48c5823 union-default release versus storage-only candidate; equal runtime defaults and pinned runner dependencies

selection.policy: First 1000 schemas in retained corpus order after llguidance-success filter; do not drop candidate failures

static.metric: native commit_i to mask_i+1; minimum complete interval across two independent runs

fresh_llguidance.scope: same-machine make example-js, original grammar; only exact LL-measured keys
fresh_llguidance.metric: mask_i + commit_i within each run; minimum of six complete pairs per position
fresh_llguidance.cache_policy: production defaults, no exact-mask-cache diagnostic override
fresh_llguidance.llguidance_grammar: llguidance uses a different grammar; masks are not assumed equal across engines

post_timing_upstream_integration.timing_scope: Timing tables retain the prior explicitly identified fa2863ef baseline and 4ed9ba3 integration; later boundary-cancellation-only upstream work was merged and functionally revalidated, not attributed to the storage change.
